text: Architect. Draws the plans for buildings and houses.
Flight attendant. Looks after people on a plane and keeps everyone safe.
Pilot. Flies the plane and checks the weather before take-off.
Artist. Makes pictures and paintings to share how they feel.
Dancer. Moves to music and tells stories with the body.
Singer. Sings songs for people to hear and sing along to.
Builder. Puts up walls, roofs and floors to make buildings.
Doctor. Checks people when they are sick and helps them get better.
Nurse. Looks after patients and helps doctors in the hospital.
Veterinarian. Helps sick and hurt animals get better.
Teacher. Helps children learn to read, count and make friends.
Firefighter. Puts out fires and helps people in emergencies.
Police officer. Keeps people safe and helps find lost things and people.
Chef. Cooks meals in a restaurant and makes new recipes.
Baker. Makes bread, cakes and biscuits early in the morning.
Farmer. Grows food and looks after animals on a farm.
Gardener. Plants, waters and trims flowers and trees.
Zookeeper. Feeds and looks after the animals at the zoo.
Scientist. Asks questions and tests them to find out how things work.
Astronaut. Flies to space and does experiments on a space station.
Bus driver. Drives people safely around the town.
Train driver. Drives trains with lots of people on board.
Sailor. Sails boats and keeps the ship working on the sea.
Lifeguard. Watches swimmers and keeps them safe at the pool or beach.
Mail carrier. Delivers letters and parcels to every house.
Librarian. Helps people find books and loves stories.
Photographer. Takes pictures of people, places and moments.
Author. Writes books and stories for people to read.
Musician. Plays instruments and makes music with others.
Actor. Pretends to be different people in plays and films.
Engineer. Designs and fixes machines, bridges and gadgets.
Coder. Writes instructions that make apps and games work.
Electrician. Puts in and fixes the wires that bring power to buildings.
Hairdresser. Cuts, washes and styles hair.
Florist. Makes bunches of flowers for people to give.
Tailor. Sews and mends clothes so they fit well.
Beekeeper. Looks after bees and collects their honey.
